plugins.name: OCcodeBridge
plugins.description: 把订阅型编码套餐接入 CPA，通过可插拔厂商适配层对接不同上游，支持多凭据管理、模型映射、统一错误规则、额度耗尽自动暂停、流式与非流式调用及请求日志。实验性通用代理池默认关闭，支持标准 HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 代理。 / Connect subscription coding plans to CPA through a pluggable vendor layer with multi-credential management, model mapping, shared error rules, automatic quota pause, streaming and non-streaming requests, and request logs. The experimental general-purpose proxy pool is off by default and supports standard HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 proxies.
plugins.author: xiao-qiu-qiu
